summary: The Data Warehouse Engineer designs, develops, and maintains enterprise data warehouses to support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence.
responsibilities: Design and implement data warehouse architectures
Develop ETL/ELT workflows to populate warehouse tables
Optimize queries and storage for performance
Collaborate with BI, analytics, and product teams
Document data models, pipelines, and schemas

education: 3–6 years of experience in data warehousing

skills_required.name: Strong SQL and data modeling skills
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts (star/snowflake schemas)
Familiarity with cloud or on-premise warehouse technologies
